title: Serve until mind and body agree
summary: Service to the True Guru does not cleanse intention alone; it makes mind and body answer to the same truth.
takeaway: Choose the service that cleans motive and behavior together.
lifeApplication: When your inner intention and outer habit split, choose a concrete service that makes both answer to the Guru’s truth.

source.shortMeaning: Serving the True Guru cleans the mind and makes the body pure.
source.lifeApplication: When life feels split, choose the service that cleans both motive and behavior.

evidence.coreClaim: Serving the True Guru cleans the mind and makes the body pure.
evidence.turn: The shabad begins with mind and body cleansed together, then widens truth into the whole life.
evidence.practicalImplication: When your inner intention and outer habit split, choose a concrete service that makes both answer to the Guru’s truth.
